app.name: Awesome Self-Hosted Directory
app.one_liner: A curated, categorized directory of free and self-hostable web applications and network services that empowers users to replace SaaSS with privacy-respecting, Free Software alternatives.

screens.name: Software Categories
screens.purpose: Display top-level categories (e.g., Analytics, Email, Backup) for navigating the self-hosted software directory.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist a selected software entry locally for later reference or deployment planning.

mvp_plan: week 1: Display license and tech stack metadata for each entry
week 1: Implement basic navigation between categories and entries
week 1: Parse and structure README content into categorized software entries
acceptance_tests: Each software entry displays its license (e.g., MIT, AGPL-3.0) and runtime environment (e.g., Nodejs/Docker).
User can navigate from main screen to Analytics category and view listed tools like ANALOG and Aptabase.
